context.issue_title: PostgreSQL operator does not exist: text = integer (C42883) in 2 integration tests
context.root_cause: Column-to-text casts without parameter casts in webhook/subscription_store.zig (line 189) and identity/service.zig (line 1410)

diagnosis.error1: src/webhook/subscription_store.zig:189 — resolveOwnerUserId() casts id::text but does not cast $1 parameter → text = uuid comparison
diagnosis.error2: src/identity/service.zig:1410 — revokeToken() casts id::text but does not cast $1 parameter → text = uuid comparison
diagnosis.pattern: Both queries use asymmetric casting (column cast but parameter not cast)

task.description:
Step 2: Design the fix for ISS-0124. Create a design artefact (src/design/ISS-0124-fix.md) that specifies:
1. Which functions are affected and where (line numbers)
2. Current buggy SQL patterns
3. Fixed SQL patterns with proper casting strategy
4. Why the fix resolves the C42883 error
5. No implementation code — design only
acceptance_criteria: Design includes the two affected locations with current/fixed SQL patterns
Design explains the type casting strategy (e.g., cast parameter to UUID or both to text)
Design is no-code — it describes WHAT to fix and WHY, not implementation details
Design references the exact line numbers and function names

result.summary: Fix design complete: Asymmetric SQL type casting fix for C42883 errors
